scope: Native-only private resident GPU-loss optimizer state, 256-byte packed-input offsets, retained checkpoint cadence and all-frame export validation. FP64 arithmetic/kernels/formats unchanged.

comparison_commits.current: native-resident-state commit containing this receipt; source hashes below

method: Three fixed rotating/alternating GPU implementations, three fresh processes each; two CPU reference processes bracketing them. No precision/work/output changes. Startup is fresh-process NVRTC/driver initialization with existing uncontrolled caches, not a claimed cold driver-cache experiment.

limits: Only three GPU and two CPU processes per case on one machine; observed ranges are not confidence intervals.
Combined changes improve public/medium vs original baseline; residency/alignment contributions not separately identified.
Medium incremental whole-process benefit vs transfer-only is unresolved. Tiny current median regresses vs transfer-only, and native CPU stays faster.
Host geometry, reduction, clipping, assessment, integrity checks, export verification and device status transfer remain.
Checkpoint format/backend identity unchanged; equality claims apply to tested states, not every possible checkpoint.
Generated datasets/models/executables/raw logs are ignored and not tracked. No new dependencies, global configuration changes or remote push.

timing_scope.startup_ms: Trainer admission/template work, NVRTC/driver initialization and initial assessments; not isolated JIT time or a cold-cache measurement
timing_scope.steady_updates_ms: Sum of reported gradient_ms and adam_ms; includes snapshots in adam_ms, excludes separate save callback IO
timing_scope.whole_process_ms: Externally measured fresh process completion including data admission, all required assessments, checkpoint/export/reload validation and process overhead
timing_scope.before_output_write_ms: Internal CLI elapsed time before final model/report writes; not whole-process time
timing_scope.nested_scopes: Do not sum all reported timing fields: startup includes initial assessment and Adam includes snapshot work
